title: Titanium Liquid Level Float
function: Hollow ball float switch for chemical tank
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this tank hardware application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. This rationale is driven by hollow ball float switch for chemical tank and fat life requirements.

inspection: Adhesion tape ASTM D3359 (hollow ball verified)
commonFailures: Precious metal drag-out >15% on complex racks - minimized by robotic extract 0.5m/min + air knife — critical for hollow ball float performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Liquid Level Float suitable for Hollow ball float switch for chemical tank?
faq.a: Titanium Liquid Level Float uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address tank hardware operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Liquid Level Float?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Liquid Level Float is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for hollow ball float requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Liquid Level Float require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. hollow ball float components require Platinum cladding 2.5um minimum via electrodeposition for stable catalytic surface in electrochemical cells — tailored for hollow ball float application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Liquid Level Float shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Liquid Level Float includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet hollow ball float specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Float switch / Level float tank hardware components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
